{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a '''station manager''' commanded [[Sel Zonn Station]], an [[XQ2 Platform]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. At some point, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Switch]] began operating out of [[Deep Storage Bay V14]] in a restricted part of the station and Switch sent his [[Unidentified Twi'lek majordomo (Sel Zonn Station)|Twi'lek majordomo]] to pay monthly bribes to the station manager, to keep the location of Switch's headquarters secret.<ref name="The Traitor's Gambit">{{DoD|The Traitor's Gambit}}</ref>
